stockSync.pageSubtitle: When an item sells on one channel, it goes down everywhere else, so you never oversell.

statusHelp.disabled: Stock sync is off. No marketplace stock is changed.
statusHelp.dryRun: Dry run: sales are counted and we work out what would be sent, but nothing is written to any marketplace.
statusHelp.live: Live: stock changes are sent to every linked channel.
statusHelp.globallyDisabled: Stock sync is temporarily paused for maintenance. Nothing is written to any marketplace.

settings.title: Status and settings
settings.restockOnCancel: Put stock back when an order is cancelled
settings.restockOnCancelHelp: Items of a cancelled order go back into stock. Returns are not added automatically.
settings.autoFixDriftHelp: If a marketplace shows more than you have, the hourly check lowers it. Stock is never raised automatically.
settings.zeroDisable: Turn off the variation (single-item listings are deactivated)
settings.seedReserved: Subtract sold-but-unshipped items from the starting stock
settings.seedReservedHelp: Items that are sold but not shipped yet are taken off the starting count.
settings.disableConfirmBody: Matches and history are kept. While off, no marketplace stock changes.

dryRunReport.title: Dry-run report
dryRunReport.wouldHaveSent: {count} stock updates would have been sent
dryRunReport.risksPrevented: {count} oversell risks would have been prevented
dryRunReport.riskExample: {sku}: after a {soldOn} sale, {exposedOn} still showed {shown} while you had {available}
dryRunReport.empty: Nothing yet. As sales come in you will see here what would be sent.

wizard.title: Stock sync setup
wizard.channelsIntro: Choose the channels whose stock you want to manage together. Each shows how long a sale there takes to reach us; during that time an oversell is possible.
wizard.matchesIntro: Listings with the same SKU are grouped into one product. Check and confirm them.
wizard.noMatches: No listings with the same SKU on more than one channel.
wizard.unmatchedIntro: These listings have no SKU or no twin on another channel. Link them by hand if you like.
wizard.generateSkusHelp: SKUs are proposed for the selected Etsy listings and saved as drafts. They reach Etsy only when you press "Sync to Etsy".
wizard.seedIntro: How should the starting stock be set?

policy.minHelp: Recommended. You enter the number for products that need a check.
policy.etsy_masterHelp: The Etsy quantity becomes the starting stock.
policy.manualHelp: You type the real count for each product.

wizard.coverage: {percent}% of the last 30 days' sales belong to matched products
wizard.previewIntro: What each listing will be set to when you go live. Nothing is sent in this step.
wizard.enableIntro: In dry run, sales are counted and we work out what would be sent, but nothing is written to any marketplace. Review the report and press "Go live" when you are ready.
wizard.needsReviewLeft: Enter a count for {count} products; they are not synced until you do.

preview.title: Preview
preview.liveRead: Reading current numbers from the marketplaces…

totals.capped: {count} listings shown with the last seen number

goLive.title: Go live
goLive.intro: When live, stock changes are written to the marketplaces. The numbers before going live are kept for 7 days so you can undo.
goLive.typeToConfirm: Some listings will be deactivated or variations turned off. Type {word} to confirm.

restore.title: Undo go-live
restore.body: Every listing is set back to its number before go-live (minus what sold since) and stock sync is turned off.

items.title: Products
items.empty: No synced products yet. Start with the setup wizard.

reasons.catalog_v3_or_unverified: Wix stock writing not verified yet
reasons.untracked: Stock tracking is off on the marketplace
reasons.untracked_or_location: Stock tracking or location not found

link.unlinkConfirm: Remove the stock link for this listing?

entries.remoteDropMatched: {channel} #{order} sale (seen first as a stock drop): −{units}
entries.pushDraft: {channel} set to {to} by the draft sync ✓
entries.pushDeactivated: {channel} listing deactivated because stock ran out

managed.tooltip: This variation's quantity comes from stock sync. If you change it here, the new number is saved as a stock correction.
managed.dryRunTooltip: Stock sync is in dry run: this quantity is not changed automatically yet.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.account_not_owned: No access to this shop account.
errors.token_invalid: The preview is not valid. Refresh and try again.
errors.token_expired: The preview expired (15 min). Refresh and try again.
errors.plan_changed: Something changed since the preview (a sale, a link or a setting). Refresh the preview and confirm again.
errors.needs_seed: Enter this product's stock count first.
